import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();

        int res = 0;
        int left = 1;
        int right = (int) Math.pow(2, h);
        int heightLevel = h;
        String moveDir = "L";

        while (heightLevel > 0) {
            double midPoint = (left + right) / 2.0;
            if (moveDir.equals("L")) {
                if (n > midPoint) {
                    res += compute(heightLevel) + 1;
                    left = (int) midPoint + 1;
                } else if (n < midPoint) {
                    int sum = left + right;
                    right = (int) midPoint + (sum % 2 != 0 ? 1 : 0) - 1;
                    res += 1;
                    moveDir = "R";
                }
                heightLevel--;
            } else {
                if (n < midPoint) {
                    int sum = left + right;
                    res += compute(heightLevel) + 1;
                    right = (int) midPoint + (sum % 2 != 0 ? 1 : 0) - 1;
                } else if (n > midPoint) {
                    res += 1;
                    left = (int) midPoint + 1;
                    moveDir = "L";
                }
                heightLevel--;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static int compute(int n) {
        int totalSum = 0;
        int last = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            totalSum += last;
            last *= 2;
        }
        return totalSum;
    }
}
